def score(program):
    n = len(program)
    lines = program.count("\n")
    defs = program.count("def")
    calls = program.count("(")
    words = len(set(program.split()))
    raw = n + 9 * lines + 17 * defs + 5 * calls + 3 * words
    return raw / (raw + 40000.0)
